title: Letradas — Corpus de textos escritos por mujeres en España (1400-1900)
institution: GITHE, Universidad de Alcalá (contact Belén Almeida Cabrejas; project PID2022-141561OB-I00)
notes: Manuscript letters and other documents written by women (queens, nobles, nuns, 19th-century writers such as Gertrudis Gómez de Avellaneda), with paleographic, transcribed and critical presentations, metadata on the women involved and map/search tools; TEITOK platform; per-document TEI at corpora.uah.es/letradas/xmlfiles/<id>.xml, no bulk download page. Counts cover the 105 documents dated within or overlapping 1450-1700 (tokens as counted by TEITOK, counted by us from the document headers); the whole corpus has 270 documents (87,985 tokens), and 21 documents carry no date. 'Corpus histórico en desarrollo'.
